status.description: done = acceptance criteria met; partial = budget hit with useful progress; blocked = cannot proceed without a decision; stopped = andon pulled (anomaly, wrong premise, scope or safety issue).

summary.description: Conclusion first, 1-5 sentences. Every key verdict or conclusion MUST cite an item in `evidence` (e.g. [E1], file:line, or command output). Unbacked claims are rejected as hallucination risk.

deliverables.description: File paths, diff locations or artifact paths. Never paste large content here.

evidence.description: Verifiable ground-truth proof: `file:line-line` + excerpt, `command -> exit/output`, measured numbers, or URL. One item per claim. Prose opinions without anchors do not count as evidence.

next_action.description: What the manager should do or decide next. Empty string if nothing.

confidence.description: Optional: worker's epistemic confidence in the result based on evidence strength.

assumptions_challenged.description: Optional: premises in the manager's brief that were falsified or misframed. MUST include a verifiable citation (`file:line` or `command -> output`) or a concrete micro-spike that proves it; unbacked skepticism goes to `risks`, not here.

open_questions.description: Optional: high-value questions, surprises, or emergent leads discovered during the work, with where they were seen (`file:line`).

handoff_notes.description: Optional: direct technical notes, invariants, or warnings (with `file:line`) for the next agent in a pipeline or review.

truth_amendments.description: Optional: formal request to amend a locked prerequisite, threshold, or shared interface in the Truth Contract when empirical evidence proves the initial value is infeasible. Never mutate shared constants silently; declare amendments here with proof so all sibling/downstream packages are updated.

key.description: Invariant or shared parameter/interface name (e.g. MAX_BATCH_SIZE, PORT, API_SCHEMA).

old_value.description: Previous locked value in Truth Contract.

proposed_value.description: New value proposed by this package.

evidence.description: Verifiable proof (`file:line` or `command -> output`) justifying the change.

affected_packages.description: Other packages that must be notified or re-synced if this amendment is adopted.
